item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】DSF - Michael Jackson - Bad (2026 Mofi SACD. DSD + CD Layer)
item.description:
Hi everyone! I'm so back after a while!

Today I bring you one of the newest SACDs by MoFi. And a truly special one:

Michael Jackson - Bad.


This could be, in my opinion, the definitive version of the album. The amount of technicalities that it has now makes it superb.
HOWEVER, i must list 2 things regarding this release:

1.- This version of "Bad" doesn't have the original mixes of the album (aka, horns in the title track, no spoken intro in IJCSLY, etc). If you don't agree with the revised mixes, please: do not post any bad comments about this release if you're not even willing to give it a try. Same thing happened with the Off The Wall SACD and it ended up being the best the album has ever sounded.

2.- This SACD has a mastering flaw: The sond engineer forgot to decrease the volume in order to avoid clipping in certain songs while mastering. Please do not mistake these new "clipping" sounds caused by this mistake, as the album ORIGINALLY had certain distortions from the recording that are present on the original japanese CD from 1987 as well. The most notorious "new" clippings caused by this are noticeable on "liberian girl & IJCSLY).

Tracklist:
1.- Bad
2.- The Way You Make Me Feel

4.- Liberian Girl
5.- Just Good Friends
6.- Another Part Of Me
7.- Man In The Mirror
8.- I Just Can't Stop Lovin' You

Enjoy!
